prompt:
Generate a single exceptionally photorealistic vertical mirror-selfie photograph of an original fictional 25-year-old adult woman. The image should have the immediate appeal of a beautiful creator's personal camera-roll photo: striking face, confident eye contact, glossy healthy hair, flattering styling and believable smartphone realism.

COMPOSITION: Exact 9:16 portrait composition, close framing from just above the hair to the upper hips. She fills most of the image. Her face sits left of center in the upper third, with the entire face clearly visible. A phone held vertically appears along the right edge beside her face, slightly below eye level, never covering an eye or her lips. Keep a small amount of headroom and a little of the lounge-pants waistband at the bottom. The mirror frame is outside the crop.

SUBJECT: An unmistakably adult woman with a striking but individual beauty-model face: softly defined high cheekbones, a gently tapered oval jaw, almond-shaped light hazel eyes, full natural brows, a straight nose and full softly shaped lips. Warm light-medium olive skin, natural feminine proportions and a gently defined waist. Preserve slight facial asymmetry. Her expression is composed, self-assured and friendly, with relaxed closed lips and a faint suggestion of a smile. Her eyes look toward the phone camera's reflection.

HAIR AND MAKEUP: Very long, dense dark chocolate-brown hair reaching her waist, with a clean center part, silky straight lengths and a slight inward bend at the ends. Most of the hair falls over both shoulders; several fine loose strands break the silhouette. Soft-glam makeup: precise short brown-black eyeliner wings, separated curled lashes, softly brushed brows, warm rosy blush and nude rose lips with a restrained satin sheen. Fine lip lines and skin texture remain visible.

WARDROBE: She is fully dressed in an elegant fitted black sleeveless going-out top with a square neckline, substantial shoulder straps and an opaque floral-jacquard fabric. The top covers her torso to the waistband and fits naturally without exaggerated shaping. Pair it with relaxed light-gray cotton lounge pants, only the upper portion visible. A fine gold necklace with a tiny oval pendant, small gold earrings and one delicate bracelet. No facial stickers.

POSE: She stands comfortably about an arm's length from the mirror, torso angled only slightly, with one hip taking her weight. Her reflected hand on the left is lifted beside her head, gently gathering a section of hair behind the ear with relaxed fingers. Her other hand holds the phone at cheek level on the right side of the picture. Shoulders stay low, head tilts slightly toward the lifted hand, and the waist turns gently. Maintain ordinary, comfortable mirror-selfie body language.

PHONE AND REFLECTION: A modern smartphone with a plain translucent smoky-gray case and three consistent rear-camera lenses. The phone is a modest foreground element, not the main subject. The hand grips its sides with believable finger placement and short almond-shaped nude nails. The rear camera faces the mirror. All reflected anatomy, the phone angle and the reflected room obey one coherent mirror geometry. One subject, one phone, one reflection.

LOCATION: An understated warm cream hotel dressing area with matte plaster walls, pale ceiling molding, a narrow walnut wardrobe panel and the cropped edge of an ivory upholstered chair. The room feels real, tidy and occupied. Background detail is limited and remains softly recognizable. No visible bed, no staged props and no text.

LIGHT: Soft warm room light, around 3300K in appearance, comes primarily from a large diffused source to the left and slightly above. Gentle ambient room bounce fills the shadows. Give the eyes small coherent catchlights, the cheekbones and collarbones soft highlights, and the hair long subtle reflections. Keep natural shadow depth along the far cheek, beneath the chin and around clothing seams. Skin retains a neutral-warm color rather than an orange cast. No flash or cinematic rim light.

PHOTOGRAPHIC REALISM: Main smartphone camera used through the mirror, with natural mild wide-angle perspective and moderately deep focus. Sharp eyes and eyelashes, normal-scale pores, faint under-eye texture, fine baby hairs, subtle uneven skin tone and small pressure marks where clothing touches skin. Keep these details understated and flattering. Real jacquard fabric texture, soft cotton folds, correct strap tension, contact shadows and tiny reflections in the gold jewelry. Restrained phone HDR and sharpening, very faint sensor texture in the shadows. Preserve a spontaneous, slightly imperfect handheld composition.

AVOID: CGI, illustration, doll-like eyes, identical facial halves, waxy skin, excessive smoothing, heavy freckling, exaggerated pores, inflated lips, exaggerated anatomy, rigid glamour posing, exaggerated facial expressions, extra fingers, fused fingers, warped wrists, extra camera lenses, a phone covering the face, duplicated reflections, bokeh cutout halos, aggressive HDR, oversharpened fabric, watermarks, text or interface graphics. Keep this an ordinary fully clothed fashion selfie.

FINAL PRIORITY: The adult woman's face, gaze, hair and relaxed confidence should make the image attractive at first glance. On closer inspection, skin, hands, fabric and mirror perspective should remain as believable as an ordinary high-quality phone photograph.
